sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Blodam is a light-element weapon used by Gustave / Verso. It scales with Vitality (C), Defense (B).

sections.title: How to Get the Blodam
sections.content:
Location: The Continent - defeat the Chromatic Reaper Cultist.

sections.title: Is the Blodam Worth Using?
sections.content: Scales off Vitality (C), Defense (B). A dedicated light pick - it belongs in a build already committed to that element.
